briefing.summary: Quiet 24 hours — no new patch or hotfix landed; 1.1.5.0 (Lighthouse/Icebreaker rework) remains the live build while attention stays on the PvE-focused 1.2.0.0 update expected late September/early October. Reddit's RSS feeds and the tarkov.dev API were both unreachable again this run, so community-sentiment and market coverage below is thin and pulled from secondary sources.

categories.title: Patch & Balance Changes
items: 1.1.5.0 (released Sept 8) is still the current build with no follow-up hotfix in the last day. It reworked Lighthouse (new Rogue positions, reworked chokepoints, BTR patrol changes), overhauled the Lightkeeper access task chain, and swapped Icebreaker's ruble toll for a one-time 'Sudak-tudak' marine repair kit earned via the 'Passing through!' quest.

Next up on the roadmap is 1.2.0.0, due late September/early October, centered on PvE mode: a new PvE Prestige system (voluntarily reset to level 1 with an empty stash/torn-down hideout in exchange for permanent, wipe-proof rewards — the only way PvE characters ever reset, since PvE has no seasonal wipe), reworked bot spawn logic and AI behavior, and better raid-reconnection handling. Nothing has shipped yet.

Further out, BSG's public roadmap points to a Unity 6 engine upgrade in October and a Season 2 update (1.4.0.0) in December bringing a new 'End of the Line' location and a new boss, Povodyr — early-stage roadmap items, not confirmed dates, but worth tracking as they approach.

categories.title: Community News
items: The Golden Coins Twitch tournament (Aug 28-29, players hunting gold/silver coins and boss kills) has wrapped, and there's no active Twitch Drops campaign running right now — nothing to redeem this week.

Reddit's RSS feeds (new and top-of-day) were unreachable for a second straight day, so this run can't confirm current community sentiment on the Icebreaker XP nerf or other 1.1.5.0 balance talk beyond what was already noted yesterday.
